No lettering, no badges, no logos.
style_building: Isometric three-quarter view from 35 degrees above of one single building made as a premium hand-painted architectural scale model, serious and detailed, matte realistic paint with crisp edges, standing on a small square slab of pavement. The whole building is in frame with a wide empty margin, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light, no lettering, no signs. style_alien: Photograph of a premium hand-painted miniature of a living organism, grown rather than built, all smooth organic surfaces: no metal, no rivets, no panel lines, no guns, no windows, no cockpit, no canopy, no fins, no engines, no lettering. Matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights. The whole object is in frame with a wide empty margin, centred, seen from 45 degrees to the front-left and slightly above, floating in mid-air, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.
style_creature: Photograph of a premium hand-painted tabletop miniature of a creature, serious and highly detailed, matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights, unsettling mood. Whole creature in frame standing directly on the ground with no base, front three-quarter view, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.
style_poster: Screen-printed travel poster of a 1950s vision of the future, flat areas of colour with crisp clean edges, a little paper grain, limited palette of teal, peach, enamel cream, mustard, graphite and soft coral sky. No text, no lettering, no title, no border, no people in the foreground.
style_texture: A perfectly flat material swatch seen straight on, orthographic, filling the whole frame edge to edge, evenly lit with no shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no objects, no border, the pattern continues past every edge. Realistic, finely detailed, matte.

items.prompt: Subject: an office desk 1.4 metres wide, 0.7 deep and 0.78 tall. A flat top of pale walnut veneer with a rounded front edge and a thin chrome band, standing on two box pedestals of cream enamel steel with three drawers each and small chrome pulls, a wire letter tray on top and a small teal enamel desk lamp with a domed shade.

Subject: a service counter 2 metres long, 0.6 deep and 0.7 tall. A long box with rounded ends, the front panel in cream enamel with three horizontal chrome bands, a teal top of linoleum with a chrome edge, a mechanical cash till in graphite and chrome at one end.

Subject: a steel shelving unit 1 metre wide, 0.4 deep and 1.2 tall. Two graphite enamel uprights with round chrome feet, three cream enamel shelves, on the shelves a few plain cardboard boxes in mustard, teal and cream and some bound files.

Subject: a single bed 2 metres long, 0.9 wide and 0.7 tall at the headboard. A low walnut frame on short tapered legs, a white mattress and pillow, a folded teal wool blanket, a curved headboard in cream enamel with a chrome rail.

Subject: a steel locker cabinet 0.8 metres wide, 0.45 deep and 1.5 tall with rounded vertical corners. Body in cream enamel, two tall doors in teal enamel with three ventilation slots near the top, small chrome handles and a chrome number plate with no number on it.

Subject: a vending machine 0.9 metres wide, 0.7 deep and 1.6 tall with a rounded top. Body in warm coral-red enamel with a polished chrome crown, a large lit display window in the upper half showing rows of small packets behind glass, a row of chrome buttons, a chrome delivery tray at the bottom.

Subject: a street lamp 3.3 metres tall. A slim tapered teal enamel post on a round stepped base, one curved arm at the top holding a drum-shaped lamp head with a frosted glass underside and a cream enamel shade, the glass glowing warm white.

Subject: a free-standing street sign board 2.3 metres tall. A single teal post, a wide rounded cream enamel board on top with a broad coral band across it carrying no letters at all, a thin teal rail along its bottom edge.
Subject: a public bench 1.8 metres long and 0.8 tall. A seat and a back rail of slatted pale timber, two curved legs of graphite enamel steel with chrome caps.

Subject: a parked two-tone civilian saloon car of a 1950s vision of the future, about 5 metres long, 1.9 wide and 1.4 tall, on four wheels half hidden under rounded wheel spats. Teal enamel lower body, a cream enamel roof and a cream trim line along each side, a clear glass bubble cabin, two small coral tail fins at the back, a chrome bumper bar and a lit headlamp strip across the nose. A ground car, wheels on the ground.
Subject: a square planter box 1 metre wide and 0.5 tall of warm red brick with a cream stone rim, planted with low clipped evergreen shrubs in two tiers rising to 1 metre.

Subject: a rooftop water tank 1.6 metres tall. A short steel drum 1 metre across in pale grey enamel with a domed coral-red lid, standing on four splayed steel legs with cross braces, a thin pipe running down one leg.
Subject: a rooftop ventilation unit 0.9 metres tall. A square grey steel housing with a dark louvred grille on the front, a round fan drum on top with a cream enamel conical cap.

Subject: a rooftop radio mast 4.6 metres tall. A slim lattice steel pole painted graphite on a square base plate, two cross bars with small insulators, a round dish antenna on one side, a red beacon lamp at the very top.
Subject: a shipping crate 0.8 metres on each side. Pale timber planks held by three graphite steel bands, a small mustard stencil plate on one face with no letters.

Subject: a one-storey streamlined self-service restaurant 20 metres long with one rounded end, a full-length band of tall windows, a cantilevered flat roof with a rounded mustard edge, a vertical cream fin over the entrance with no letters, cream and teal enamel panels.

Subject: a two-storey goods depot 30 metres long: a big shed of ribbed sheet steel painted blue-grey under a low curved roof, three large mustard roll-up loading doors along the front, a small two-storey office block with ribbon windows at one end, a short loading dock.

Subject: a civic hall: a broad four-storey block with rounded corners and a raised entrance porch of four slim square piers, a stepped central tower rising to eight storeys with a round clock face near its top and a short flat crown, long ribbon windows, cream walls with teal bands.

Subject: an industrial works: a long two-storey factory hall with a sawtooth roof of glazed north lights, two round storage tanks beside it, a single tall round chimney with two chrome rings, pipe racks between them, cream and graphite walls with mustard doors.

Subject: a small four-seat civilian flying car of a 1950s vision of the future, about 4.5 metres long. A rounded teardrop body in pale cream enamel with a mustard belly, a clear bubble canopy, chrome trim lines, two small round ducted lift fans in pods on short stub wings. No wheels; it hovers a little above the ground.

Subject: a giant smooth seed pod about 6 metres long, a spindle three times as long as it is wide, tapering to a soft point at both ends. Milky pearl-white skin like polished porcelain with a cool grey sheen. Five raised hoops of dark glossy brown-black chitin wrap around it from end to end. Thin glowing amber filament lines run under the skin between the hoops. It hangs in the air with nothing holding it.

Subject: a giant lumpy gourd about 12 metres long and 6 tall lying on its side, its swollen body covered in heavy overlapping curved plates of dark glossy brown-black chitin with smooth milky pearl-white skin between them. Under its belly hangs a tight bunch of a dozen round translucent amber pods, each glowing softly from inside. It hangs in the air with nothing holding it.

Subject: an enormous smooth larva about 60 metres long with no legs and no head, a long body of twelve ribbed rings of dark glossy brown-black chitin tapering at both ends, the top of every ring covered by a smooth milky pearl-white plate like polished porcelain, two long straight rows of small round glowing amber lights along each flank. It hangs in the air with nothing holding it. The whole body in frame.

Subject: a squat alien organism about 0.9 metres tall, not shaped like a person or an animal. A heavy pear-shaped body of smooth milky pearl-white skin like polished porcelain with thin glowing amber filament lines under it, standing low on four short thick jointed legs of dark glossy brown-black chitin. At the front of the body hangs one large translucent sac the size of the body's head end, glowing amber from inside and full of round spores, below a short upturned chitin tube like a mortar barrel made of shell. No eyes, no face, no arms.

Keep the figure's exact shape, pose, proportions, clothes, camera and white background. Repaint only the alien head and any growths: the skin becomes a cool smooth milky pearl-white like polished porcelain with a faint blue-grey sheen, no green anywhere. The growths on top of the head become three raised ridges that glow amber from inside like a lamp filament. A soft amber glow shows at the throat above the collar.

The legs stay dark glossy brown-black chitin. The core stays a soft glowing amber.
